theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only eligible, scorable leader group flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.61, crowded true) while still trend-healthy (durability 0.75, hurst 'trend', breadth 0.6). Crowding is a size-down caution only, not a fade or short; the lean here expresses the caution that risk-adjusted upside from current levels is poor relative to other eligible trend-healthy themes, not a prediction of an outright decline.
theses.dissent: Trend health is genuinely strong and breadth is broad; crowding in a durable trend can persist far longer than a sizing caution implies, and absolute-trend-gated exposure has historically avoided the worst shake-outs.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the #2 eligible theme, trend-gated and uncrowded (crowding_z 0.93 but crowded false), with the widest breadth among leaders (0.636) and a strong durability bar (0.62). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and this theme remains inside it. This is a measured trend-following lean within an eligible, uncrowded, broad theme, not a buy-on-rank argument.
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro-narrative-sensitive sector and the macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled geopolitical headlines (unscheduled_share 0.75); a headline-driven reversal could break the trend quickly despite the gate.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its absolute-trend gate and the theme drops out of the eligible set before the check-by date
